dedupe_keys.name: aero cam localization dataset at alora viaduct

description: CATEC publishes AERO-CAM sensor recordings from drone flights beneath a bridge at Álora, Spain. Zenodo supplies five ROS bag files free under CC BY 4.0, recorded on 10–11 March 2021 using a DJI M600 Pro platform. Channels include Ouster OS0-128 LiDAR, inertial measurements, GPS, pressure, laser altitude and total-station reference positions, with sensor transforms documented. These recordings can benchmark localisation components in bridge-inspection digital twins. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this experiment. Coverage is the particular bridge and flight sessions, not a labelled catalogue of structural defects. Occlusion, synchronisation and reference-position uncertainty constrain interpretation, and localisation success does not establish damage-detection accuracy. No ROS bags were downloaded, trajectories reconstructed or navigation algorithm executed.
